capabilities: Solve coding exercises in .leetany files inside the vault
Run fixed local tests against solutions and compare failing output with expected answers
Mark passed exercises with a checkmark in the vault
Generate exercises from lesson notes using an external coding agent

extras: Requires Obsidian Desktop 1.15+ and Python 3.10+; tests execute locally with OS permissions and the README warns to only open exercises from trusted sources. Manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian notes can describe programming lessons but offer no way to solve exercises and run tests against them in the vault.
